supports_model.mismatch_notes: Core coefficient identities agree. Net-area continuity is project-derived. Chart conditions, fixed initial angle, geometry limits and the incomplete source performance procedure make the whole implementation a repository extension.

comparison.source: Eq. (7), PDF p.20 (printed 8): psi = g H / u_t2^2.
comparison.implementation: tip_speed = sqrt(g stage_head / psi), with D2 = 2 tip_speed / omega.
comparison.verdict: EQUIVALENT algebra for positive inputs. Staged head splitting and the configured coefficient remain project selections.

comparison.source: Fig.16, PDF p.42: phi2 = c_m2/u2; chart at best efficiency, zero prewhirl, shrouded impellers and diameter ratio 0.65.
comparison.implementation: achieved_phi = Q/(open_perimeter b2 tip_speed); blade-count lookup uses psi and phi.
comparison.verdict: EQUIVALENT coefficient identity. Chart conditions are not established for every coupled geometry, and all digitized nodes were not independently rechecked here.

comparison.source: Sec.3.3.1.3, PDF p.79: inlet free area greater than 80 percent; discharge greater than 85 percent; four to eight inlet blades.
comparison.implementation: Exit blockage Z t/(pi D2 sin(beta2)), net-area continuity and main/splitter blade selection.
comparison.verdict: PROJECT_DERIVED_GEOMETRIC_CLOSURE consistent with the free-area concept. The expanded Q = b2 (pi D2 - Z t/sin(beta2)) c_m2 relation was not located as a displayed source equation on these pages.

comparison.source: Secs.3.3.1.2 and 3.3.1.3, PDF pp.78-79: iterate blade number, angle and diameter for the head-flow curve; quasi-three-dimensional and stability analysis.
comparison.implementation: Initial 25-degree exit angle, geometry closure, slip-based velocity triangle and repository limits.
comparison.verdict: REPOSITORY_EXTENSION: these functions do not implement the full source design and stability procedure.

comparison.source: Sec.2.3.1.2, PDF p.40: head coefficients approximately 0.35 to above 0.70 and flow coefficients 0.05 to 0.30.
comparison.verdict: INSIDE_REPORTED_DESIGN_VALUES. Those general ranges do not validate or optimize these selections for a particular pump.

model_review.citation_vs_support: SP-8109 supplies coefficient definitions, a conditional design chart, and free-area and performance criteria. The complete code is a repository preliminary screen, not qualified pump performance.
model_review.software_verification: Engineering suites were not run; direct source/code inspection only.
model_review.execution_reach: Not dynamically traced. Scope is the raosim.pumps path, not a separate audit of the MDO solver.
model_review.physics_finding: No engineering changes. Preserve chart conditions and project-derived closure. Qualified head-flow, slip, efficiency, cavitation and stability evidence remains unavailable.
remaining_uncertainties: All Fig.16 digitization nodes and clamping behavior were not independently reverified.
The chart diameter ratio 0.65 and best-efficiency scope are not established for every coupled geometry.
Source velocity-gradient and stability requirements need analyses or measurements beyond kinematic closure.
Specific-speed and specific-diameter unit conventions are not promoted as raw numerical chart identity.
